author: Marcus R. Brown
description:
Deletes a high-severity advisory rather than mitigating it.

`@lhci/cli` is flagged abandoned on the dependency dashboard — last release 2025-06-25 — and it drags in the only copy of `extract-zip <= 2.0.1`, [GHSA-jmr9-qjv8-65gv](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-jmr9-qjv8-65gv). That advisory has **no patched release at any version**, so there is nothing to override to. The dependency was the advisory.

## Nothing invoked it

Its sole consumer was `scripts/accessibility-audit.sh`, and that script has no npm script, no workflow, and no reference anywhere outside the `.ai/` archive.

The script is 76 lines. Its only actual tool invocation:

```sh
npx lhci autorun --upload.target=filesystem --upload.outputDir=./lighthouse-reports \
  --collect.url="http://localhost:6006/iframe.html?id=form--default" \
  --collect.settings.chromeFlags="--no-sandbox" || true
```

Everything else is `echo` statements and a `curl` liveness check against Storybook. The `|| true` means even that one command swallowed its own failures.

It would not have worked regardless — `lighthouserc.js` is listed as FILE-009 in `.ai/plan/infrastructure-testing-framework-1.md` and was never written, so `lhci autorun` had no configuration to read.

## The audit that actually runs is unaffected

`docs/package.json` defines:

```json
"a11y:audit": "tsx scripts/accessibility-audit.ts",
"a11y:audit:ci": "tsx scripts/accessibility-audit.ts --ci"
```

That is a different file — `docs/scripts/accessibility-audit.ts` — and it imports only `node:fs`, `node:path`, and `node:process`. Lighthouse was never part of the path that runs.

Two accessibility-audit implementations existed with similar names; only the TypeScript one was ever wired up.

## Effect

`pnpm-lock.yaml` drops from 823134 to 784786 bytes — the whole `puppeteer-core` / `lighthouse` / `@puppeteer/browsers` subtree goes with it.

Open advisories go from 31 to 30, with one fewer high and no mitigation debt. [description truncated to fit budget]
title: chore(deps): remove abandoned @lhci/cli and its orphaned audit script
